name: Super Pure Runtz Hash Holes | 1g
description: .85g flower + .15g rosin hand rolled with a custom glass tip. Super Pure Runtz may deliver a euphoric and relaxing high. Its effects may be felt in both the head and body. This strain is known to reduce anxiety and stress, as well as soothe mild aches and pains in the body.
